summary: Parse per-media insight responses' values[] time-series shape so reach/views/saved/shares/total_interactions record real figures instead of 0.
reason: fetchInsightTotals read only the account-level total_value scalar; per-media insights ignore metric_type and return the values[] shape with no total_value, so the collector silently persisted 0 for every media metric. total_value presence is now detected by key presence (pointer), keeping precedence for a present-but-zero/empty scalar while falling through to values[] for the media shape.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ passes; new parseInsightTotals cases cover the media values[] shape, present-but-zero and present-but-empty total_value precedence, and null total_value fall-through. Live: top-posts --metric reach matches a direct Graph API call (211/330) that previously read 0.
